_source: SIA 265:2021, clause 3.4.2.3, equation (5), with 3.4.2.2 and 4.5.2.5 -- transcribed by hand from the German edition, SIA265-2021-DE.pdf pp. 26, 27 and 40, read off a render of p. 27.
_note: k_h = (reference_height / h)^exponent <= maximum, h in mm. A permission ("dürfen"), for f_m,d of Brettschichtholz (Tabelle 9) with h below the reference height only. Solid timber (3.3.2, 3.3.3) has no height factor. Not together with k_sys for bending about z (3.4.2.2), and not in the fire situation (4.5.2.5).

clause.note_z: About z the height is b. 3.4.2.2 lets the bending design values about z be raised by k_sys and forbids k_h «gleichzeitig» with it: k_h about z is allowed where k_sys is not applied, which Woodcore never does (the engineer, 12.10.2026, spec 2026-10-12-audit-issues-47-48-49, D-12).
clause.label: Höhenbeiwert

not_with.note: Nicht gleichzeitig mit k_sys bei Biegung um die z-Achse.
